name: dropify-mcp
description: The hub for official-store product data. Prices, stock, restocks and new drops on 500k+ merch products, by API or MCP.
long_description: Dropify is the hub for official-store product data. It tracks official artist and brand merch stores. Stores span the US, UK, EU, Canada, Australia, Japan and Korea. The API and MCP server read 500k+ products. Each has price, currency, stock, image and store link. Each product's detail adds stock by size. A change feed lists restocks, new drops, price changes and sell-outs. This bundle has 10 read-only tools. Seven need a Dropify token, and three work without one. Tokens come with All Access. All Access covers the site, the API and MCP.

tools.name: find_brand
tools.description: Fuzzy-match an artist or brand name against Dropify's tracked brands.

tools.name: official_stores
tools.description: List the official stores Dropify tracks for a brand.

tools.name: restock_alert_link
tools.description: Get the Dropify page where restock and drop alerts are set for a brand.

tools.name: list_artists
tools.description: Artists on your plan, with an optional name filter.

tools.name: list_stores
tools.description: Stores on your plan, or one artist's stores.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: The newest products, filtered by artist, store or stock.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: One product, with price and stock for each size.

tools.name: recent_changes
tools.description: Restocks, new drops, price changes and sell-outs since a time you set.

token.title: Dropify token
token.description: Optional. Adds the 7 token tools to the 3 that work without one. Tokens come with All Access. Create one at https://app.dropify.cloud/developers.
